overview_description.description:
Ravion is the agent-native cloud infrastructure platform for AWS.

It gives developers, AI agents, and DevOps one governed place to provision, deploy, and operate applications in their own AWS account.

Get production-grade AWS without building every DevOps capability yourself. Start with production-ready modules and pipelines, bring existing infrastructure, customize the system, and adopt Ravion incrementally as your needs grow.

Ravion connects infrastructure, deployments, failures, logs, and metrics without taking away AWS ownership or native access.

product.name: Flightcontrol Platform
product.description: A platform that automates deployment and infrastructure management on AWS accounts, enabling developers to deploy servers, Lambdas, databases, and other services without deep AWS or DevOps expertise.

product.name: Ephemeral Preview Environments
product.description: Automatically provision temporary, cost-optimized AWS infrastructure for each pull request to enable testing and collaboration before merging code.

product.name: DevOps Support Add-ons
product.description: Supplementary DevOps support services providing expert guidance and 24/7 emergency response to assist teams without full-time DevOps engineers.

product.name: Nixpacks Build System
product.description: A build system that enables deployment of any language or framework without requiring a Dockerfile, serving as a modern alternative to Heroku buildpacks.

identifier.value: Multi-region Deployment and AWS Service Integration

product.name: Multi-region Deployment and AWS Service Integration
product.description: Capability to deploy applications across 28 AWS regions with support for multiple AWS services like ECS, Lambda, RDS, ElastiCache, and CloudFront CDN.
